car.name: Suzuki Swift 1.2 MHEV, manual 2WD
car.market: UK brochure reference; not a Bengaluru fleet average
car.accelerationNote: SUMO generic passenger-car desired acceleration; not a Swift performance measurement.
car.sourceLocation: Suzuki brochure PDF page 18, manual 2WD column.

twoWheeler.name: TVS Raider model-family reference
twoWheeler.market: Chile dimensional specification and India performance release; model-family proxy, not one certified variant
twoWheeler.accelerationNote: Derived mean Δv/Δt = (60/3.6)/5.9 = 2.825 m/s² from the published factory 0–60 test. Used as an initial IDM parameter, not peak acceleration or a fitted speed-dependent curve.
twoWheeler.sourceLocation: TVS technical dimensions; TVS SmartXonnect press release, 0–60 km/h in 5.9 s and top speed 99 km/h.

autoRickshaw.name: Bajaj RE250
autoRickshaw.accelerationNote: 0.6 m/s² is an engineering starting value informed by the paper’s three-wheeler approach means (0.350–0.552 m/s²). The observed mean 0.427 is not itself the IDM free-road acceleration parameter; no fitted RE250 dynamics are claimed.
autoRickshaw.sourceLocation: Bajaj RE250 technical specifications; Ramireddy et al. 2021 Table 1, PDF page 5.

lightCommercial.name: Tata Ace Gold Diesel BS6 Phase 2
lightCommercial.accelerationNote: SUMO generic truck acceleration used as an initial proxy. The Ace brochure does not publish a numeric acceleration curve; this is not manufacturer-measured Ace acceleration.

bus.name: Tata Starbus 4/12 EV
bus.accelerationNote: SUMO city-bus desired acceleration. Manufacturer lists acceleration only as “As per CMVR”, without a numeric rate; 1.2 is not a measured Starbus rate.
bus.sourceLocation: Tata brochure PDF page 2: nominal length 12050 + 50 mm; body width excludes mirrors.

truck.name: Tata LPT1618, 4800 mm wheelbase
truck.market: Historical Euro-II export/LHD reference; not a current Indian legal or governed-speed specification
truck.accelerationNote: SUMO generic rigid-truck desired acceleration; not an acceleration measurement for this LPT variant.
truck.sourceLocation: Tata export brochure dimensions/performance; overall length is 8665 mm for the 4800 mm wheelbase, not cargo-deck length.
